hypothesis.statement: Existing user-provided originals contain a small but measurable expression range that can seed deformation QA without fabricating emotion or viseme authority.
hypothesis.action: Human-label only unambiguous neutral, smile and mouth-open sources; extract eye, mouth and corner geometry with MediaPipe; preserve all other requirements as missing.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Expression coverage rises from 0/16 to evidence-backed 3/16 while the remaining 13 cases continue to fail closed.

defects.finding: Angry, sad, eyes-closed and all 10 requested speech/viseme reference states are absent.
defects.recommendedAction: Capture or generate a controlled same-identity expression sheet, then require human identity and label review before registration.

defects.finding: Smile and mouth-open sources are wider upper-body crops than the neutral face master.
defects.recommendedAction: Use the fixed Looking Glass Go face close-up camera for post-conform MetaHuman comparison; do not compare raw pixel scale across these source images.

decision: Keep the three reviewed labels as deformation evidence only. Do not derive viseme labels or an expression quality score from landmark thresholds.
nextEvidence: controlled same-identity angry, sad, eyes-closed and viseme sheet plus post-conform MetaHuman close-up renders under the Go profile
